# Templates

Copy, rename, fill. Keep the section headings — reviewers and agents rely on
them. Delete the guidance in *italics* once the section is written.

| Template | Used for | Lives in |
|----------|----------|----------|
| `problem-statement.md` | The single discovery document | `00-discovery/` |
| `research-note.md` | One external topic investigated | `00-discovery/research/` |
| `prd.md` | Product requirements | `01-requirements/` |
| `user-story.md` | One story (stories may also be collected in one file) | `01-requirements/` |
| `adr.md` | One architecture decision | `02-architecture/adr/` |
| `feature-spec.md` | One feature, implementation-ready | `03-specs/` |
| `process-log-entry.md` | One working session | `04-process/process-log.md` |
